highlights: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, its most capable model for business, alongside new APIs for agents and real-time voice, significantly advancing enterprise AI integration.

Significant developments in AI agents are emerging, with AWS introducing an open-source inbox for background agents and Google Research releasing a framework for high-quality tool-use data generation.

The AI model landscape is expanding with specialized and cost-efficient solutions, including Cognition's SWE-2 coding model, Cohere's North Small Translate for multilingual tasks, and Sakana AI's Fugu models for multi-agent orchestration.

agents.title: Introducing the Agents API
agents.summary: OpenAI has launched the Agents API, a managed service powered by the Codex harness, enabling developers to build and deploy cloud agents with orchestration, long-running sessions, and robust tool use capabilities.

agents.title: AWS Introduces Pizza Bot: An Open Source Inbox for Background AI Agents
agents.summary: AWS released Pizza Bot, an open-source, self-hosted inbox for AI agents built on DeepAgents and LangGraph, offering persistent task state, MCP integrations, configurable approvals, and scheduled workflows across multiple model providers.

agents.title: Google Research Releases ToolGrad: Answer-First Framework Hits 99.8% Pass Rate for Tool-Use Data Generation
agents.summary: Google Research unveiled ToolGrad, a framework that generates high-quality tool-use datasets by creating verified API chains first, achieving a 99.8% pass rate on ToolBench and enabling strong fine-tuning results with minimal samples.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
models.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Astra, their most capable model designed for business, featuring advanced reasoning, enhanced computer use, and superior judgment for writing and design tasks.

models.title: Cognition Releases SWE-2: A Kimi K3 Post-Trained Coding Model That Matches Fable 5.1 on FrontierCode at 64% Lower Cost
models.summary: Cognition released SWE-2, a powerful coding model post-trained with reinforcement learning from Kimi K3, achieving performance comparable to Fable 5.1 on FrontierCode at significantly reduced costs (64% lower).

models.title: Cohere Releases North Small Translate: A 218B MoE Translation Model That Scores 83.6 on WMT26 Across 50 Languages
models.summary: Cohere launched North Small Translate, an open-weight Mixture-of-Experts model for machine translation across 50 languages, demonstrating strong performance (83.6 on WMT26) with efficient parameter usage.

tools.title: Build more natural voice experiences with GPT‑Live‑1 in the API
tools.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT‑Live‑1 in the API, enabling developers to create natural, full-duplex voice conversations with stronger instruction following, custom voices, and integrated telephony support.

tools.title: Introducing @huggingface/kernels: 200+ WebGPU Kernels for Local AI
tools.summary: Hugging Face launched `@huggingface/kernels`, a collection of over 200 WebGPU kernels, designed to enable efficient local AI execution directly within web browsers, unlocking new possibilities for client-side model inference.

tools.title: Anthropic Adds Plugin Evals to Claude Code: 6 Grader Types, a No-Plugin Baseline, and a CI Gate for Skills
tools.summary: Anthropic released a new plugin evaluation workflow for Claude Code, providing developers with six grader types, a no-plugin baseline, and a CI gate to robustly measure plugin effectiveness and skill triggering.

companies.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Financial Services
companies.summary: OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services, combining built-in financial data with GPT-6 Astra capabilities to enhance research, modeling, and client-ready material generation for the finance sector.

companies.title: Expanding AI access and cyber defense for federal, state, local, and tribal governments
companies.summary: OpenAI, in partnership with GSA, is offering eligible U.S. government entities $0 license fees, 50% off usage, and expanded cyber defense support to increase AI adoption and security in the public sector.

companies.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
companies.summary: Perplexity is leveraging OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to manage its end-to-end systems, including communications, software changes, and production monitoring, leading to less human intervention compared to previous models.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Kaggle's AI Agents Intensive, in collaboration with Google, offered a free course to 353,000 learners, guiding them to build and deploy advanced AI agents, highlighting a major push in accessible AI upskilling.

learning.title: Implementation of Machine Learning Workflows with NVIDIA cuML, RAPIDS, GPU Benchmarking, Explainability, Clustering, and Model Inference
learning.summary: This practical tutorial provides a guide to building and accelerating machine learning workflows using NVIDIA cuML and RAPIDS, covering GPU setup, zero-code acceleration, performance benchmarking, and model explainability with GPU-accelerated SHAP.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: This guide explains how to train and finetune multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, providing practical steps for developers to enhance semantic search and retrieval applications.
